# sampling for the random walk (or Hamiltonian Monte Carlo): truncated normal proposal distributions (the ranges and SDs are estimated from the TFs)
    posterior_temp$tf_sample[,1] <- rtruncnorm_cpp(num_taxa,posterior$tf_sample[[i-1]][,1],sds_tann,tf_quarts_tann[,1], tf_quarts_tann[,3])
    posterior_temp$tf_sample[,2] <- rtruncnorm_cpp(num_taxa,posterior$tf_sample[[i-1]][,2],sds_pann,tf_quarts_pann[,1], tf_quarts_pann[,3])
    
       
    # current reconstruction
    taxa.appear.core <- posterior_temp$taxa.appear.core.temp
    reconst <- taxa.appear.core[reconst_ages,] %*% posterior_temp$tf_sample
    predictant_tann <- reconst[,1]
    predictant_pann <- reconst[,2]
    
    
    
    
    posterior_temp$youngest_values <- reconst[1,]
